claims.text: Pendry Park City is a ski-in / ski-out resort in the center of Canyons Village, steps from the high-speed Sunrise Gondola.

findings.quote: A ski-in / ski-out resort nestled in the center of Canyons Village and just steps from the new high-speed Sunrise Gondola

claims.text: The Sunrise Gondola's 10-person cabins offer sweeping mountain views and trailhead access.

findings.quote: Board a 10-person cabin for sweeping mountain views, trailhead access and endless outdoor adventure above it all.

claims.text: The guestrooms and suites use natural, warm design elements with a contemporary, modernist feel that pays homage to the mountain landscape.

findings.quote: Pendry Park City’s 175 guestrooms and suites pay homage to the mountain landscape with natural, warm design elements made anew with a contemporary, modernist feel throughout.

claims.text: The guestrooms have views of the Utah landscape and the surrounding resort.

findings.quote: our inspired guestrooms provide striking views of the Utah landscape and surrounding resort

claims.text: The suites have kitchenettes, a nook seating area and designer amenities.

findings.quote: our 24/7 private fitness center, featuring state-of-the-art equipment, including Peloton, TechnoGym and more

findings.quote: Located slopeside with ski-in / ski-out access, the lobby lounge and bar offers fireside seating, live music

claims.text: KITA is a Japanese-inspired steakhouse and sushi restaurant.

findings.quote: KITA, a Japanese-inspired steakhouse and premium sushi restaurant

claims.text: In summer, mountain biking is just steps from the hotel.

findings.quote: Pendry Park City stuns with signature indoor and mountainside spaces, including a grand ballroom
